s: Whose help did Vijayaramaraju take in Bobbili War?
x:
The Battle of Bobbili (1757) was fought between the rulers of Vizianagaram and Bobbili. Pusapati Vijayarama Raju, the ruler of Vizianagaram, sought the assistance of the French commander Marquis de Bussy. With the support of French troops and artillery, Vijayarama Raju attacked the Bobbili Fort. Although Bobbili was defeated after heroic resistance, the bravery of Tandra Paparayudu, who later assassinated Vijayarama Raju, made the battle one of the most celebrated episodes in the history of Andhra Pradesh.
